title: Static methods inside Java interfaces
answer: Yes. Java interfaces can declare static methods. A static interface method belongs to the interface type itself, so it is normally called as InterfaceName.method(). It is not inherited as an instance method by implementing classes, which keeps the utility associated with the contract rather than with an object instance.
